name: UNI-ROYAL-chip-thick
title: Thick film chip resistors, 01005 to 2512, 1/32 W to 1 W, 0 Ω jumpers and 0.01 Ω to 10 MΩ
summary: A family of thick film surface-mount resistors on an alumina substrate in ten case sizes from 01005 to 2512, rated 1/32 W up to 1 W at 70 °C ambient. Values run from 0.01 Ω to 10 MΩ in ±0.5 %, ±1 %, ±2 % and ±5 % tolerances (E-96 and E-24), and each size also comes as a 0 Ω jumper below 50 mΩ. Terminations are Ni/Cr, a nickel barrier and tin; the parts take reflow and, from 0603 up, wave soldering, and are RoHS compliant and halogen free. They run from -55 °C to 155 °C (01005 to 125 °C) and ship taped on 178 mm reels.

notes: A part number has 14 characters: four for the size (0105 stands for 01005), two for the power rating, one for tolerance, four for the value, one for the packing type (T, tape on reel), one for the reel quantity and one for special features (E, standard).
Example: 0805W8J0103T5E is an 0805, 1/8 W, ±5 %, 10 kΩ resistor, 5,000 on a reel.
Value code, E-24 values: a leading 0, two significant digits, then the power of ten. E-96 values: three significant digits, then the power of ten. 0000 is the 0 Ω jumper.

operation.text: Full rated power holds from -55 °C up to 70 °C ambient. Above 70 °C it falls in a straight line to zero at 155 °C, or at 125 °C for the 01005.

The continuous voltage a resistor may carry, DC or AC rms, is the one that dissipates its power rating, √(P × R), capped at the max. working voltage of its size. Short overloads go to 2.5 times that value, capped at the max. overload voltage.
Low-ohm parts carry a higher rating: an 0805 below 0.1 Ω is rated 1/4 W against 1/8 W, and a 1206 below 0.1 Ω is rated 1/3 W against 1/4 W. These low values come in ±1 %, ±2 % and ±5 % only.
Every size has a 0 Ω part, under 50 mΩ, rated for a continuous current from 0.5 A (01005, 0201) to 2 A (0805 and up) and an overload current from 1 A to 10 A.

All sizes take reflow with lead-free Sn96.5/Ag3/Cu0.5 solder, peaking at 260 °C, at most twice; a nitrogen reflow oven keeps the end terminations from discolouring. Wave soldering applies from 0603 up. The profiles are starting points to be tuned to the application.

Keep reels at 15 to 35 °C and 25 to 75 %RH; even then solderability falls after a year. Cartons stand the way their marking shows, or reels and tape deform. Avoid static, sunlight, rain, snow, condensation, sea air and corrosive gases such as Cl2, H2S, NH3, SO2, NO2 and Br.
The parts are meant for boards thicker than 1.6 mm; for thinner boards UNI-ROYAL asks to be consulted for a better-suited part.
Listed uses are GPS navigators, mobile phones, telecom, PDAs, set-top boxes and meters.
